in this dialogue
that he doesn’t mind people using these images for non-commercial purposes]
Subscribe
This post’s title is a little cheeky. Brian Eno does not have an explicit theory of democracy that I know of, although he is visibly and emphatically committed to its practice. But Eno’s arguments about the arts tell us important things about how democracy ought work, and what kinds of democratic stability and variety we ought aspire to.
The back story to this post doesn’t start with Brian Eno. Back in 1991, the political scientist Adam Przeworski published a book,
Democracy and the Market
. Most of the book was about the democratic transition in Central and Eastern Europe, and it was very good as best as I can judge these things. But the first chapter was much,
much
better than very good. It laid out a brief theory of democracy that reshaped the ways in which political scientists think about it.
Przeworski’s theory
starts from a simple seeming claim
: that “democracy is a system in which parties lose elections.” It then uses a combination of game theory and informal argument to lay out the implications. If we assume (as Przeworski assumes) that parties and political decision makers are self-centered, why would the ruling party ever accept that they had lost and relinquish control of government? Przeworski argues that it must somehow be in their self-interest to so. He argues that they will admit defeat if they see that the alternative is worse, and (this is crucial) because democracy generates sufficient uncertainty about the future that they believe they might win in some future election. They know that they will hurt their interests if they refuse to give in, and they have some (unquantifiable but real) prospect of coming back into power again. Democracy, then, will be stable so long as the expectation of costs and the uncertainty of the future give the losers sufficient incentive to accept that they have lost.
This is a more beautiful idea than I am able to explain in a brief post, and certainly much more beautiful than any argument I will ever come up with myself. It compresses a vast and turbid system of enmeshed ambitions and behaviors into a deceptively simple nine word thesis. That thesis can then be unfolded into a variety of more detailed models of how democracy may sustain itself through the interlocking ambitions of politicians who strive to win office, but grudgingly accept that they must leave it if they lose. If Przeworski’s argument is not well known outside political science, it is likely because it is a chapter in a book that is mostly about different questions from a different time. But within political science, it is rightly regarded as a classic. If you have a Ph.D. in comparative politics, or even a good undergraduate degree, you will likely have been required to read it as a photocopy or a PDF.
Equally, Przeworski’s argument leads you to think about democracy in some ways, and not others. It suggests that the central elements of democracy are a set of self-reinforcing expectations about the alternation of power, which can be mapped with game theory. Many political scientists were inspired by Przeworski’s ideas to come up with more formal models of democracy, ditching Przeworski’s claims about uncertainty and informal arguments in favor of greater determinacy and cleaner math. Personally, I think that Przeworski’s initial, messier formulation better captures some of the dynamics of the system,.
This understanding implies that as soon as democracy has become established, it will continue to work into the indefinite future, because everyone’s expectations converge in ways that reinforce each other.  Once a democracy has become sufficiently wealthy and established, parties and leaders should recognize that they have too much to lose from destabilizing the system. It would take a massive external shock (e.g. a major economic crisis), remaking the environment that democracy works in, to shift people out of their ordinary beliefs and behaviors.
These assumptions mostly stem from the way that game theorists think about the world. In their language, democracy is a self enforcing equilibrium, which will just keep on going so long as the parameter values don’t shift too radically. You don’t have to worry too much about destabilizing forces emerging from
within
democracy.
Unfortunately, it has become clear to many (including Przeworski himself) that this understanding can’t really explain why democracy is degenerating in the U.S. and elsewhere. Look around you: there are visibly circumstances under which democracy

data.title: I built a pixel art editor after playing Octopath Traveler II
data.author: Kobayashiii
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕一款像素艺术编辑器的评价和建议，讨论涉及不同工具的比较、功能增强的建议以及对像素艺术本身的探讨。

不同观点：
• [roflcopter69] 认为该编辑器目前功能较为基础，但有潜力，并推荐了另一个像素艺术编辑器 Pixelorama，认为其具有更多功能和社区支持，且使用 Godot 引擎开发是其优点。
• [sabslikesobs] 分享了自己使用 Krita 进行像素艺术创作的体验，指出 Krita 的一些强大功能如批量导出插件和自定义笔刷，适合低分辨率绘画。
• [neuroelectron] 对现代像素艺术风格的真实像素网格对齐和分辨率限制提出疑问，建议开发一种具有640x480分辨率和扫描线模拟效果的工具。
• [prashnts] 提出为移动用户增加触摸操作支持的具体建议，以改善用户体验。
• [PeterHolzwarth] 回顾了经典的 Deluxe Paint III 像素编辑器，认为其是30年前最好的像素编辑工具。
• [vunderba] 强调了像素艺术编辑器中多缩放级别实时预览功能的重要性，以帮助创作者在游戏环境中查看作品效果。
• [somefuckingguy] 分享了自己开发的类似工具，具有动画功能，并提供了相关链接供参考。
• [hombre_fatal] 认为该项目目前状态过于简单，不值得分享，并对提及无关游戏 Octopath Traveler II 表示不满。
• [christophilus] 借机表达了对游戏公司 Square 近期3D重制的失望，希望其能用类似 Octopath 的风格重制经典游戏。
• [socalgal2] 对使用 Netify 而非 GitHub Pages 托管静态页面提出疑问，询问是否有后续功能开发计划。

补充讨论：
• [kubb] 作为一个像素艺术新手，询问学习像素艺术的建议和流程。
• [ThinkBeat] 作为一个工具新手，询问如何在编辑器中添加更多瓷砖（tiles），显示出对工具使用的不熟悉。
• [emigre] 和 [shawn_w] 简单表达了对该编辑器的喜爱和赞赏。

争议焦点：
• [hombre_fatal] 对项目当前状态和无关联游戏的提及表示不满，认为这是不必要的关联尝试。
• 不同用户对像素艺术工具的功能和使用场景有不同偏好，如 [roflcopter69] 推荐 Pixelorama 而 [sabslikesobs] 偏好 Krita。

data.title: DotnetSnes: Library allowing to use C# to create SNES ROMs
data.author: ingve
data.article_summary: **DotnetSnes** 是一个允许使用 .NET 语言创建真实 SNES 游戏 ROM 的库。它通过一个 .NET 库（DotnetSnes.Core）抽象 SNES 游戏开发中的函数和全局变量，编译后的 DLL 通过 "Dotnet To C" 转译器（dntc）转换为 C 代码，再使用 PvSnesLib SDK 工具链生成可用的 ROM。由于 SNES 的限制，编写时需注意系统级类型支持、无动态内存分配、最小化堆栈变量等。开发环境建议使用 Linux 或 WSL，依赖包括 cmake、g++、dotnet-sdk-8.0 等。项目示例包括简单的 "Hello World" 和更复杂的 "LikeMario" 游戏示例，展示了对象管理、地图、音频和手柄输入。要创建新项目，需设置 .NET 类库，引用必要库，并配置 Makefile 以定义 ROM 构建过程。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：F#与Rust的互操作性及其局限性

不同观点：
• reverseblade2认为可以通过Fable工具将F#代码转换为Rust，并提供了一个GitHub链接（https://github.com/ncave/fable-raytracer），展示了一个F#到Rust的光线追踪器项目。这表明他支持通过工具链实现F#与Rust的互操作。

• SideburnsOfDoom则指出了这种方式的严重局限性，特别是缺乏动态内存分配和不支持引用类型、类实例。他认为这些限制会从根本上改变语言的特性，可能导致在实际应用中遇到很多困难。

补充讨论：
• rawling提到了在三周前有相关讨论，可能暗示这个话题并非新问题，之前已有社区成员关注和讨论过。

• 争议的焦点在于F#通过Fable转换为Rust的可行性和实用性。一方认为这种工具可以有效利用，另一方则认为语言特性的改变会导致实际使用中的问题。

• 一个值得注意的细节是，SideburnsOfDoom提到的限制涉及到F#的核心语言特性，这些特性在转换到Rust后可能无法保留或实现，从而影响项目的架构和实现方式。

通过这些观点，可以看出社区对于F#与Rust互操作的关注点主要集中在工具的可行性、语言特性的保留以及实际应用中的限制和困难。

No dynamic allocations are supported (thus no reference type support)
Minimizing variables on the stack is important
Pointer/address tracking is common to save memory
Even with these limitations, it is still possible to create real SNES games, though there might be instances where
it may be necessary to go to a lower level than C# supports.
Note:
The dntc transpiler has its own limitations on what MSIL operations it supports and doesn't yet support, so
it's possible to hit code that should work but the transpiler does not yet have support for.
Getting Started
There are several things to be aware of before getting started
The PVSnesLib SDK works best under Linux. If developing on windows, you'll want to do the final compilation of the
SNES rom under WSL, but obviously you can use windows emulators to test the resulting rom.
This repository should be cloned using
ssh
credentials. This is because all submodules (and submodules within
submodules) are using
git@
addresses and I have not yet figured out a good way to allow them to be mixed. See the
Github SSH key docs
for help.
Make sure to do a full recursive submodule update after cloning (e.g.
git submodule update --init --recursive
)
Dependencies needed to install on WSL Ubuntu for make
export PVSNESLIB_HOME=(yourpath)/DotnetSnes/pvsneslib
sudo apt-get update
(if needed)
sudo apt-get install cmake
sudo apt-get install g++
sudo apt-get install dotnet-sdk-8.0
Preparing the Repo and SDKs
Clone the DotnetSnes repository
Do a recursive submodule initialization on the clone to get dependent projects
git submodule update --init --recursive
cd
into the
pvsneslib/
directory and run
make
This will make sure the pvsneslib toolchain is now built
Hello World Example
The Hello World is a basic example that shows a bare minimum SNES rom that prints text to the screen.
cd
into
src/DotnetSnes.Example.HellowWorld/
run
make
You should see
Build finished successfully !
and a
HelloWorld.sfc
should now exist in your
bin/Release/net8.0
folder. This is your SNES rom that you can load into an emulator, or save to flash cart.
LikeMario Game Example
mario.mp4
This is a C# port of the
PVSnesLib LikeMario example
, which
demonstrates how to manage objects, tmx tile maps, audio, and game pad input.
Important classes are:
Globals.cs
contains assembly labels for where content exists in the
baked in rom.
Game.cs
contains the logic for initializing the game
Mario.cs
contains the logic for showing and controlling the mario object
To build:
cd
into [src/DotnetSnes.Example.LikeMario]
run 'make'
The
LikeMario.sfc
rom file should now exist in the
bin/Release/net8.0
folder.
Creating a New Project
To start a brand-new project:
Create a new .net class library project
Reference the
DotnetSnes.Core
library
This provides core functionality needed by SNES roms
Reference the
Dntc.Attributes
library
This provides pretty important attributes thatare useful for the transpilation process
Create a
public static int Main()
function declaration to declare your rom's entry point
Add the
[CustomFunctionName("main")]
attribute to your
Main()
function, to force it to have
main
as the
function name after transpiling to C. This allows the SDK to know it's the entry point.
Create a file named
Makefile
with the following contents:
.SUFFIXES
:
SNES_NAME
?= HelloWorld
#
Replace with the name you want your rom to have
SNES_DLL ?=
$(
ARTIFACTS_ROOT
)
/DotnetSnes.Example.HelloWorld.dll
#
Replace with the DLL your csproj will generate
ARTIFACTS_ROOT ?=
$(
abspath
bin/Release/net8.0)
DNSNES_CORE_DIR
?=
$(
abspath
../DotnetSnes.Core)
#
43868395.article_summary: **DotnetSnes** 是一个允许使用 .NET 语言创建真实 SNES 游戏 ROM 的库。它通过一个 .NET 库（DotnetSnes.Core）抽象 SNES 游戏开发中的函数和全局变量，编译后的 DLL 通过 "Dotnet To C" 转译器（dntc）转换为 C 代码，再使用 PvSnesLib SDK 工具链生成可用的 ROM。由于 SNES 的限制，编写时需注意系统级类型支持、无动态内存分配、最小化堆栈变量等。开发环境建议使用 Linux 或 WSL，依赖包括 cmake、g++、dotnet-sdk-8.0 等。项目示例包括简单的 "Hello World" 和更复杂的 "LikeMario" 游戏示例，展示了对象管理、地图、音频和手柄输入。要创建新项目，需设置 .NET 类库，引用必要库，并配置 Makefile 以定义 ROM 构建过程。

主要讨论点：网页自动播放声音的有效性与用户接受度

不同观点：
• [支持观点] **jflessau** 认为网页自动播放声音在某些使用场景下（如通知、游戏音效）是合理的。他指出，虽然大部分人可能不希望网页发出声音，但这些特定的用例是有其存在价值的。

• [反对观点] **xingped** 强烈反对网页自动播放声音，表示自己从未希望在不主动点击播放的情况下听到任何网页声音。他认为视频播放是唯一可以接受的声音来源。

• [技术批评] **Magma7404** 提到由于默认禁用声音设置和过去20多年Flash网站带来的困扰，导致他不会允许网页发出声音。他对项目本身表示祝福，但个人不会接受声音功能。

• [积极反馈] **YousefShanawany** 对现代网页音效持积极态度，称赞其为“非常不错的现代音效”，并对分享表示感谢。

补充讨论：
• 用户对网页自动播放声音的接受度与过去不良体验（如Flash网站）密切相关，许多用户已经习惯于禁用网页声音。
• 争议的焦点在于自动播放声音的使用场景和用户控制权。一些用户认为在特定用例下声音是有用的，而另一些用户则坚决反对任何非用户主动触发的声音。

data.title: Jewels linked to Buddha remains go to auction, sparking ethical debate
data.author: akbarnama
data.article_summary: 一批与佛陀遗骸相关的珠宝将于香港苏富比拍卖，引发伦理争议。这批珠宝包括近1,800颗珍珠、红宝石、蓝宝石和图案金箔，1898年出土于印度北部一座佛塔，伴随被认定属于佛陀的骨灰。这些文物在一个多世纪里由英国私人收藏，如今拍卖引发对出售 sacred 遗物的伦理质疑。历史学家认为这些遗物属于佛陀的释迦族后裔及全球佛教徒。苏富比称已进行尽职调查，确保合法性。但专家质疑是否应将人类遗骸作为商品交易，以及谁有权决定这些遗物的归属。佛教领袖担忧拍卖违背佛陀教义，因这些遗物应永久供奉。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：宗教文物是否应作为商品出售，特别是涉及佛教圣物时，有关道德和所有权的问题。

不同观点：
• **[k310]的观点**：认为这些物品是 stolen goods（被盗物品）。他引用了佛教的教义，指出佛陀接受礼物作为信仰的象征，但只保留了三宝（佛、法、僧），并强调分享会增加其价值，而不是通过囤积获利。这表明他反对将宗教文物作为商品出售，特别是以营利为目的。

• **[cyberpunk]的观点**：表示这样的行为是令人震惊的（appalling），并质疑任何人是否有权利出售此类物品，尤其是如果它们是 genuine（真实的）。这暗示了对真品宗教文物商业化的强烈反对，并对物品的真实性和销售行为的合法性提出质疑。

• **[nprateem]的观点**：认为这些所谓的“发现”并没有太大的考古价值，因为很多佛塔中的圣物早已为人所知或声称拥有。他将这种行为比作抢劫教堂或博物馆，暗示这种行为是不道德的，并质疑发现和出售这些文物的合法性和道德性。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于宗教文物是否应被商业化。这涉及到所有权、发现者的权利以及宗教教义中的道德问题。
• 评论中隐含了对文物商业化的普遍反对，尤其是当这些物品被视为具有宗教或精神意义时。
• 真实性和来源的合法性也是讨论的重要方面，反映了人们对文物市场不透明和可能涉及非法活动的担忧。

Jewels linked to Buddha remains go to auction, sparking ethical debate
3 hours ago
Share
Save
Soutik Biswas
India correspondent
•
@soutikBBC
Share
Save
Courtesy: Sotheby's
The jewels comprise nearly 1,800 pearls, rubies, sapphires, and patterned gold sheets
On Wednesday, a cache of dazzling jewels linked to the Buddha's mortal remains, which have been hailed as one of the most astonishing archaeological finds of the modern era, will go under the hammer at Sotheby's in Hong Kong.
For over a century these relics, unearthed from a dusty mound in northern India in 1898, have sat largely unseen, cradled by a private British collection.
Now, as the gems prepare to leave the custody of their keepers, they are stirring not just collectors' appetites but also some unease.
They come from a glittering hoard of nearly 1,800 pearls, rubies, topaz, sapphires, and patterned gold sheets, first glimpsed deep inside a brick chamber near the Buddha's birthplace in present-day Uttar Pradesh in India.
Their discovery – alongside bone fragments identified by an inscribed urn as belonging to the Buddha himself – reverberated through the world of archaeology. Nicolas Chow, chairman of Sotheby's Asia and worldwide head of Asian Art, believes this is "among the most extraordinary archaeological discoveries of all time".
Yet as these relics now face the glare of the auction room, experts tell the BBC that a question hangs heavy: can the sale of treasures so intimately woven into India's sacred past be considered ethical?
Courtesy Peppé family
William Claxton Peppé, an English estate manager, excavated the stupa and found the jewels
In 1898, William Claxton Peppé, an English estate manager, excavated a stupa at Piprahwa, just south of Lumbini, where the Buddha is believed to have been born. He uncovered relics inscribed and consecrated nearly 2,000 years ago.
Historians agree these relics, intact until then, are the heritage of both the Buddha's Sakya clan descendants and Buddhists worldwide. The bone relics have since been distributed to countries such as Thailand, Sri Lanka and Myanmar, where they continue to be venerated.
"Are the relics of the Buddha a commodity that can be treated like a work of art to be sold on the market?" wonders Naman Ahuja, a Delhi-based art historian. "And since they aren't, how is the seller ethically authorised to auction them?
"Since the seller is termed the 'custodian', I would like to ask – custodian on whose behalf? Does custodianship permit them now to sell these relics?"
Chris Peppé, great-grandson of William, told the BBC the family looked into donating the relics, but all options presented problems and an auction seemed the "fairest and most transparent way to transfer these relics to Buddhists".
Julian King, Sotheby's international specialist and head of sale, Himalayan Art, New York told the BBC the auction house had made a thorough review of the jewels.
"As is the case with any important items and collectibles that are offered for sale at Sotheby's, we conducted requisite due diligence, including in relation to authenticity and provenance, legality and other considerations in line with our policies and industry standards for artworks and treasures," King said.
Ashley Thompson, of Soas University of London, and curator Conan Cheong, both experts in Southeast Asian art, have more questions. In a joint statement they told the BBC: "Other ethical questions raised by the sale are: should human remains be traded? And who gets to decide what are human remains or not? For many Buddhist practitioners around the world, the gems on sale are part and parcel of the bones and ash."
The sale of the relics has also sparked concern among Buddhist leaders.
"The Buddha teaches us not to take other people's possessions without permission," Amal Abeyawardene of London-based British MahaBodhi Society, told the BBC. "Historical records indicate that the Sakyamuni clan were granted custody of these relics, as the Buddha emanated from their community. Their wish was for these relics to be preserved alongside adornments, such as these gems, so that they may be venerated in perpetuity by the Buddha's followers."
Icon Films
The jewels were unearthed from this stupa in Piprahwa,  northern India in 1898
Chris Peppé has
written
that the jewels passed from his great-uncle to his cousin, and in 2013 came to him and two other cousins. That's when he began researching their discovery by his great-grandfather.
The Los Angeles-based television director and film editor wrote he had found 1898 newspaper reports - from Reuters to the New York Tribune - announcing the find of Buddha's remains.
"The colonisation of India by the British had been a source of some cultural shame for me [and continues to be] but, amidst the treasure hunters who hauled their finds back to England, there had also been people focused on the pursuit of knowledge," Chris Peppé writes.

data.title: Hello My Perverted Friend
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文由Dr. Neal Krawetz撰写，介绍了他如何开始开发取证工具的经历。他在1988年莫里斯蠕虫事件期间开始关注计算机安全，但直到十年后追踪垃圾邮件发送者时，才正式开始开发这些工具。Krawetz详细描述了垃圾邮件中的隐藏信息（秘密通道），例如通过伪造邮件头和重复使用的垃圾邮件进行隐蔽通信。他发现了一些组织，包括菲律宾的小学生团体以及犯罪组织和国家支持的行动者，利用这些秘密通道传递信息。随着垃圾邮件过滤器的改进，这种秘密通信逐渐消失。如今，垃圾邮件的数量和明显骗局已大大减少，但Krawetz仍在分析剩余垃圾邮件是否存在其他动机，如敲诈。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：垃圾邮件中的隐藏信息和诈骗行为的动机及有效性

不同观点：
• [breakingcups] 怀疑所谓垃圾邮件中的“隐藏信息”以及后续勒索邮件的复杂动机。他们认为，许多垃圾邮件发送者只是模仿他人行为的青少年，而非具有深谋远虑的聪明人。垃圾邮件发送者往往是新手，试图通过大量发送邮件来获得成功。
• [ivraatiems] 认为诈骗邮件之所以存在，是因为它们在某种程度上有效。即使回复率极低，发送成本也很低，因此只要有一小部分人上当受骗，诈骗者就能获利。同时，他们对为何有人会相信并支付表示困惑，并怀疑是否存在比勒索更好的诈骗方式。
• [cheschire] 认为，尽管勒索行为难以防范，但垃圾邮件和垃圾电话依然广泛存在，可能是因为它们提供了某种程度的匿名性。相比之下，定向勒索风险更大，可能暴露更多犯罪信息。
• [OuterVale] 指出特定类型的垃圾邮件非常普遍，且多年保持基本不变，只是稍作修改。他们观察到，某些邮箱每天会收到大量相同内容的邮件。

补充讨论：
• [genewitch] 对垃圾邮件中存在隐秘信息的说法表示嘲讽，暗示这种想法过于夸张。
• [immibis] 分享了自己收到与电动自行车相关的垃圾邮件的经历，并对为何有人会通过垃圾邮件购买商品表示不解。他们还提到，某些邮件可能只是用于测试邮件服务器等技术目的。

争议焦点：
• 垃圾邮件发送者的真实身份和动机：一方认为他们是试图模仿成功案例的青少年，另一方则认为诈骗邮件是经过精心设计的，具有特定目的。
• 垃圾邮件的有效性和持续存在的原因：讨论了为何垃圾邮件依然普遍存在，以及为何简单的诈骗手段仍然有效。

Hello my perverted friend
Saturday,  3 May 2025
At conferences and when first meeting customers, I'm often asked how I got started developing forensic tools. I've been involved in computer security since before "computer security" became a term of art. (People didn't really think about 'computer security' until the
Morris Worm
in 1988. I was in college when
that
happened. It was exciting!) However, I didn't start developing forensic tools until a decade later, when I started tracking down spammers. It's been nearly 30 years and I still read, classify, and archive every spam message that I receive.
Sometimes I wonder why spammers still do it, and the answer isn't always obvious. Back in 2003/2004, I gave a presentations on covert channels in spam. I had identified over a dozen groups that were hiding messages in spam. The basic gist:
Back then, anyone could forge the email sender. This meant that the sender was anonymous. (Newer technologies, like SPF (2014) and DKIM (2011), put a stop to completely forged headers.)
The emails were sent to a large mailing list. Most of the recipients were chaff; only a few addresses in the list were intentional. Unfortunately, nobody (except the sender) had the entire list, so no external observer could identify the intended recipients. This made the intended recipient anonymous.
The covert message would be hidden somewhere in the email -- in the header, subject, or buried in the content. If you didn't know to look for it, you wouldn't see it.
Any email message would work, but spam was ideal. The sender could re-use any spam message as camouflage. The unintended recipients (regular people) had already been trained to see and delete spam, so nobody (well, except me) would look closely enough to see the covert message.
I had been categorizing spam based on the sending tool signatures (email headers) and spam contents. The re-used spam messages really stood out. "Hey, that content is from the guy in Detroit, but that's not his tool signature!" The first time I had a mismatch, it was a covert channel and I could see the hidden message plain as day. At the time, I had been hanging out in hacker forums, where people write in "
leet speak
" (replacing letters with similar shaped characters, phonetic spelling, and horrific abbreviations). The message was in leet:
[gvjrFov-ka1AsHb3-oOGIgZSseoUJF]
It translates as:
[gvjr Fov - ka1AsH b3 - oO G I gZSseo UJF]
[Governor of - class B - oh gee I guess UJF]
A few days later, I saw this message:
[whQZsFOtOcY-AWw9fYuTUvLS-EBdh4gbj2Py5H]
It translates as:
[whQZs FOtO cY - AW w9f Yu TUvLS - EBdh4gbj2 Py5H]
[Who's photo Cy? I love your tools -
something in Tagalog
Psych]
Long story short, this series of messages came from a group of Filipino elementary school kids having fun with covert messages in spam. (They called themselves "The Hangouters" because they would hang out together. "Cy" was short for Cybersad. She was the collector and distributor of tools for the group.) While unintentional, these kids showed me how to spot covert messages. As soon as you can see it, you start seeing it often. (This is the
Baader-Meinhof Phenomenon
or "red car theory"; when you learn to see it, you notice it more often.) I quickly identified a few other 'covert channels in spam' groups, including organized crime, nation-state actors, and other organizations. It wasn't just kids.
Covert channels in spam dried up when spam filters got better. I mean, there's no point in sending hidden messages in spam if some upstream filter silently blocks the spam and prevents the intended recipient from seeing the message.
The volume of spam today is nothing like it was a few decades ago. A lot of the obvious scams are either gone or significantly reduced in volume. For the ones that are left, I have to wonder if there is an ulterior motive?
Extortion(?)

Date: Tue, 29 Apr 2025 10:36:41 +0300
From: Dawson Monroe <[REDACTED]@piplslovers.ru>
To: [REDACTED]@[REDACTED].com
Subject: New Message

43883587.article_summary: 本文由Dr. Neal Krawetz撰写，介绍了他如何开始开发取证工具的经历。他在1988年莫里斯蠕虫事件期间开始关注计算机安全，但直到十年后追踪垃圾邮件发送者时，才正式开始开发这些工具。Krawetz详细描述了垃圾邮件中的隐藏信息（秘密通道），例如通过伪造邮件头和重复使用的垃圾邮件进行隐蔽通信。他发现了一些组织，包括菲律宾的小学生团体以及犯罪组织和国家支持的行动者，利用这些秘密通道传递信息。随着垃圾邮件过滤器的改进，这种秘密通信逐渐消失。如今，垃圾邮件的数量和明显骗局已大大减少，但Krawetz仍在分析剩余垃圾邮件是否存在其他动机，如敲诈。

不同观点：
• [breakingcups] 怀疑所谓垃圾邮件中的“隐藏信息”以及后续勒索邮件的复杂动机。他们认为，许多垃圾邮件发送者只是模仿他人行为的青少年，而非具有深谋远虑的聪明人。垃圾邮件发送者往往是新手，试图通过大量发送邮件来获得成功。
• [ivraatiems] 认为诈骗邮件之所以存在，是因为它们在某种程度上有效。即使回复率极低，发送成本也很低，因此只要有一小部分人上当受骗，诈骗者就能获利。同时，他们对为何有人会相信并支付表示困惑，并怀疑是否存在比勒索更好的诈骗方式。
• [cheschire] 认为，尽管勒索行为难以防范，但垃圾邮件和垃圾电话依然广泛存在，可能是因为它们提供了某种程度的匿名性。相比之下，定向勒索风险更大，可能暴露更多犯罪信息。
• [OuterVale] 指出特定类型的垃圾邮件非常普遍，且多年保持基本不变，只是稍作修改。他们观察到，某些邮箱每天会收到大量相同内容的邮件。

补充讨论：
• [genewitch] 对垃圾邮件中存在隐秘信息的说法表示嘲讽，暗示这种想法过于夸张。
• [immibis] 分享了自己收到与电动自行车相关的垃圾邮件的经历，并对为何有人会通过垃圾邮件购买商品表示不解。他们还提到，某些邮件可能只是用于测试邮件服务器等技术目的。

争议焦点：
• 垃圾邮件发送者的真实身份和动机：一方认为他们是试图模仿成功案例的青少年，另一方则认为诈骗邮件是经过精心设计的，具有特定目的。
• 垃圾邮件的有效性和持续存在的原因：讨论了为何垃圾邮件依然普遍存在，以及为何简单的诈骗手段仍然有效。

data.article_summary: 该仓库提供了各种开关的弹跳行为示例轨迹，可作为实现电路和固件去抖动系统的参考数据。测试了多种开关，包括摇臂开关和按钮开关，记录了开关在不同条件下的电压变化轨迹。所有测试均使用相同设备和程序，每个开关进行了32次按压测试，收集了64条轨迹数据（上升/下降沿）。提供了PWL文件，可用于模拟开关电阻随时间的变化，帮助设计有效的去抖动方案。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于去抖动（debouncing）的技术讨论及其相关因素的分析

不同观点：
• ChrisGammell 推荐了Jack Ganssle的一个多部分去抖动系列文章，认为这是嵌入式系统中去抖动的经典参考资料。
• dtgriscom 讨论了噪声或电磁干扰（EMI）对信号的影响，提出如果上拉或下拉电阻足够强，则可以在第一次信号变化时立即做出反应，并在一定时间常数后才确认反方向的变化。这样可以在不遗漏按键点击的情况下尽快响应。
• londons_explore 对机械抖动的可预测性提出了疑问，指出金属的共振频率应是可预测的，但对图中显示的更混乱的波形表示不解。
• formerly_proven 强调了一个重要因素，即由于使用了x1探头，输入电容约为50-60 pF，导致200 kHz的低通效应，这会减弱高频振荡，并指出MCU引脚的电容更低，实际波形可能更复杂。

补充讨论：
• nickdothutton 表达了对硬件工作的感慨，庆幸自己不需要处理这类硬件问题，间接反映了去抖动问题的复杂性。

争议焦点：
• 讨论的核心争议在于去抖动方法的有效性和信号中出现的不规则波形的成因。londons_explore 和 formerly_proven 对波形的混乱程度和成因有不同的见解，前者认为机械抖动应更可预测，而后者指出测量设备本身的电容效应可能导致波形变化。

总结：评论中涉及了去抖动技术的不同方面，包括噪声干扰、信号变化的处理、机械抖动的可预测性以及测量设备对波形的影响。

Switch bouncing traces
This repository contains a collection of example traces showing switch bouncing behaviour. This may be useful if you want some quick reference data for implementing robust debouncing systems in your circuits and firmware.
Devices tested
Device
Type
Notes

(
archive
,
datasheet
)
Rocker switch, latching, DPST
Only one pole tested.
Schurter 1301.9206 (
archived catalogue
)
Rocker switch, latching, SPST
Old part, been in my drawer for over ten years.

(

Very large industrial pushbutton.

(

Push button, momentary, SPDT
IP65 rated. NO and NC traces recorded.
Lorin IRL-5-M-D-2
(
archive
,
datasheet
)
Key switch, momentary, DPDT
Only one pole recorded, only NO trace recorded as the NC legs were cut off.
Test conditions
The switches were configured as pull-downs, i.e. opening the switch leaves the voltage a +5.0V, and closing the switch pulls the output voltage to ground.
All traces were collected using the same procedure and equipment:
Connect 5.0V to one terminal of the switch through a 10kΩ resistor.
Connect 0.0V to the other terminal of the switch, directly.
Measure voltage across the switch.
250MHz probe (x1)
PicoScope 3206B recording at 8.93MSa/s
2V trigger, 1.5% hysteresis, 20% pre-trigger, both edges
Press the button 32 times, resulting in 64 total traces (rising/falling edges)
Approximately 8 presses in 1 second spacings (holding for momentary).
Approximately 8 presses in rapid succession.
Approximately 8 presses with light or glancing actuation.
Approximately 8 presses with heavy force.
If the switch is double-throw, record measurements for both the NO and NC contacts.
Plots
These plots show 32 opening and 32 closing actions on top of each other for each device.
Remember that the switches were configured as pulldowns, so high voltage = open, low voltage = closed.

data.title: Elvish – Scripting language and interactive shell
data.author: kartikarti
data.article_summary: Elvish 是一个强大的脚本语言和多功能交互式 shell，支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 和 Windows。它尚未发布 1.0 版本，但已足够稳定，可用于脚本编写和交互操作。Elvish 提供详细的用户文档和开发文档，源码采用 BSD-2-Clause 许可，部分代码基于 Go 和 Clojure 等项目，采用不同许可。Elvish 拥有 5.9k 个星标和 311 个分支，由 95 位贡献者开发，主要使用 Go 语言编写。项目网站为 [elv.sh](http://elv.sh)。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同用户对新型Shell（如Elvish、fish、rc shell、Nushell等）的评价和使用体验

不同观点：
• **支持使用简化Shell（如rc shell）**：
   - [gatane] 认为 rc shell 比 bash 更简单，提供了必要的功能如函数、循环和列表，且没有其他 shell 那么复杂。
   - 支持简化 Shell 的设计，避免过度复杂化。

• **偏好使用 fish，并结合 Python 处理复杂任务**：
   - [Arcuru] 长期使用 fish，喜欢其简单的语法，尤其是用于交互式 shell。对于更复杂的任务，会使用 Python 的 `sh` 或 `plumbum` 包，而不依赖 shell 本身的复杂功能。
   - 不愿意学习类似但非完全相同的语言（如 Elvish、xonsh）。

• **对 Elvish 的文档和设计不满**：
   - [photonthug] 认为 Elvish 的文档冗长且难以理解，尤其是对外部命令的解释过于繁琐，像是 AI 生成的。对 Elvish 的新规则和设计感到困惑。

• **对 Elvish 的批评和失望**：
   - [rendaw] 发现 Elvish 的文档不完善，缺乏对后台任务的支持，且开发似乎已经停滞。认为 Elvish 是一个半成品，不符合其对现代化 Shell 的期望。

• **zsh 的支持者和 fish 的对比**：
   - [linsomniac] 认为 zsh 加上一些插件已经足够好，没有实际的缺点。对 fish 的语法变化（如 "end" 代替 "fi"）不以为然，觉得没有显著的好处。zsh 更适合有长期 bash 使用经验的人。

• **支持 Nushell 的数据处理能力**：
   - [account-5] 喜欢 Nushell 处理数据格式的功能，认为比 bash 更易用，且不像 Elvish 那样依赖外部命令解析。

• **比较不同 Shell 并询问使用体验**：
   - [IshKebab] 认为很多 Shell 都比 Bash 好，但需要更多理由来选择 Elvish 而非 Nushell。
   - [atiq-ca] 对 Elvish 是否有类似 PowerShell 的 OOP 功能感兴趣。
   - [baobun] 询问其他人对 Elvish 的日常使用体验。

补充讨论：
- 用户对新型 Shell 的期待主要集中在简化语法、易用性、文档质量以及对复杂任务的支持。
- Elvish 的文档和开发停滞问题引起较多不满。
- 不同用户对 fish、zsh 和 Nushell 的偏好反映出对传统与现代 Shell 设计的不同需求和看法。
- 对 Shell 的 OOP 功能（如 PowerShell）的需求也被提及，显示出对更多编程功能集成的兴趣。

43843902.article_summary: Elvish 是一个强大的脚本语言和多功能交互式 shell，支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 和 Windows。它尚未发布 1.0 版本，但已足够稳定，可用于脚本编写和交互操作。Elvish 提供详细的用户文档和开发文档，源码采用 BSD-2-Clause 许可，部分代码基于 Go 和 Clojure 等项目，采用不同许可。Elvish 拥有 5.9k 个星标和 311 个分支，由 95 位贡献者开发，主要使用 Go 语言编写。项目网站为 [elv.sh](http://elv.sh)。
43843902.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同用户对新型Shell（如Elvish、fish、rc shell、Nushell等）的评价和使用体验

不同观点：
• **支持使用简化Shell（如rc shell）**：
   - [gatane] 认为 rc shell 比 bash 更简单，提供了必要的功能如函数、循环和列表，且没有其他 shell 那么复杂。
   - 支持简化 Shell 的设计，避免过度复杂化。

• **偏好使用 fish，并结合 Python 处理复杂任务**：
   - [Arcuru] 长期使用 fish，喜欢其简单的语法，尤其是用于交互式 shell。对于更复杂的任务，会使用 Python 的 `sh` 或 `plumbum` 包，而不依赖 shell 本身的复杂功能。
   - 不愿意学习类似但非完全相同的语言（如 Elvish、xonsh）。

• **对 Elvish 的文档和设计不满**：
   - [photonthug] 认为 Elvish 的文档冗长且难以理解，尤其是对外部命令的解释过于繁琐，像是 AI 生成的。对 Elvish 的新规则和设计感到困惑。

• **对 Elvish 的批评和失望**：
   - [rendaw] 发现 Elvish 的文档不完善，缺乏对后台任务的支持，且开发似乎已经停滞。认为 Elvish 是一个半成品，不符合其对现代化 Shell 的期望。

• **zsh 的支持者和 fish 的对比**：
   - [linsomniac] 认为 zsh 加上一些插件已经足够好，没有实际的缺点。对 fish 的语法变化（如 "end" 代替 "fi"）不以为然，觉得没有显著的好处。zsh 更适合有长期 bash 使用经验的人。

• **支持 Nushell 的数据处理能力**：
   - [account-5] 喜欢 Nushell 处理数据格式的功能，认为比 bash 更易用，且不像 Elvish 那样依赖外部命令解析。

• **比较不同 Shell 并询问使用体验**：
   - [IshKebab] 认为很多 Shell 都比 Bash 好，但需要更多理由来选择 Elvish 而非 Nushell。
   - [atiq-ca] 对 Elvish 是否有类似 PowerShell 的 OOP 功能感兴趣。
   - [baobun] 询问其他人对 Elvish 的日常使用体验。

补充讨论：
- 用户对新型 Shell 的期待主要集中在简化语法、易用性、文档质量以及对复杂任务的支持。
- Elvish 的文档和开发停滞问题引起较多不满。
- 不同用户对 fish、zsh 和 Nushell 的偏好反映出对传统与现代 Shell 设计的不同需求和看法。
- 对 Shell 的 OOP 功能（如 PowerShell）的需求也被提及，显示出对更多编程功能集成的兴趣。

data.title: A novel scientific theory: The Law of Adaptive Dissipative Organization
data.author: ElThinker
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了适应性耗散组织定律（Law of Adaptive Dissipative Organization）的科学基础，结合了热力学、统计物理学和生命起源的新理论。核心观点是，生命体和复杂系统通过耗散能量（如热量）来维持自身的组织和结构，这种自组织过程是自然选择和适应的结果。文章引用了Ilya Prigogine的非平衡热力学理论，强调在能量耗散过程中，系统能够自发地形成有序结构。Jeremy England等科学家的研究进一步提出，生物系统通过最大化能量耗散来实现自组织，这一过程在生命起源和进化中起关键作用。文章还涉及了自由能原理（Free Energy Principle），解释了系统如何通过最小化自由能来维持自身的稳定和适应环境变化。总的来说，这些理论为我们理解生命和复杂系统的自组织现象提供了新的物理学视角。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于GPT-4o提出的"适应性耗散组织法则"（LADO）的评论和讨论，以及对引用格式和内容原创性的争议。

不同观点：
• [treetalker] 认为文章中的引用形式（气泡链接）以及将其置于句子末尾标点之前的做法是不合适的。他指出这种排版方式影响阅读体验，属于不良的排版设计，容易导致阅读错误。

• [ElThinker] 分享了GPT-4o生成的科学假说——LADO，试图解释物理、生物和智能系统中复杂性出现的统一规律。他提到该假说将热力学、进化论、神经网络和信息理论联系起来，并提供了完整的科学论文，包含参考文献、可测试的预测和数学草图。ElThinker认为这一假说即使有错误，也可以作为讨论熵与组织问题的有用框架。

• [moktonar] 对GPT-4o生成的内容持怀疑态度，认为互联网上已有许多类似研究，而大语言模型只是将不同研究“拼凑”在一起，形成看似新颖但缺乏真正原创性的内容。他将这种行为类比为图像生成中的“拼凑”，缺乏真正的创造性。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是GPT-4o生成的LADO假说是否具有真正的原创性和科学价值。一方面，ElThinker认为该假说可能提供了一种新的视角和讨论框架；另一方面，moktonar则认为这仅仅是已有研究的拼凑，缺乏创新。

• 另一个值得注意的点是[treetalker]对文章排版和引用格式的批评，这涉及到阅读体验和学术规范的问题。虽然这是一个小问题，但在学术交流中，良好的排版和引用格式对读者的理解和信任有重要影响。

主要讨论点：关于LLM（大型语言模型）能力评估基准的有效性和预测价值

不同观点：
• [hatefulmoron] 认为Y轴应代表模型在循环任务中的实际进展能力，即模型能否在一段时间内自主解决问题。他对当前模型的表现感到失望，并认为自己未仔细查看细节是问题所在。

• [aoeusnth1] 支持当前的基准，认为任务成功率50%的基准是有预测价值的，尽管有人批评任务时长不能完全代表任务难度。他指出，尽管有许多因素影响任务难度，但平均任务时长仍然是衡量难度的好指标。他批评Gary Marcus的观点，认为其忽略了基准的预测能力。

• [yorwba] 建议通过收集不同难度的任务来测试AI的表现，尤其是那些人类表现较好但AI表现较差的任务。这将有助于明确AI当前的局限性，而不是简单地否定所有进展。

• [sandspar] 对Gary Marcus的批评持嘲讽态度，认为其观点过于可预测和重复，建议其不必详细撰写文章，因为结论总是相同。

• [Nivge] 认为基准是基于特定数据集的，虽然不能完全代表AI的整体进展，但仍有其价值和意义。

• [Sharlin] 暗示对某些人未考虑特定软件任务的基准可能不适用于所有认知任务表示不满，似乎对这种局限性并不意外。

• [dist-epoch] 指出某些批评可能基于过时的信息，并提供了一个链接，显示ChatGPT已经通过了某个被认为失败的测试，暗示讨论应基于最新数据。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于任务时长是否是衡量AI能力的有效指标，以及当前基准是否具有足够的代表性和预测价值。
• 一些评论者如[aoeusnth1]和[Nivge]认为基准尽管有局限性，但仍有价值，而[hatefulmoron]和[sandspar]则对基准和AI表现持怀疑或批评态度。
• [yorwba]和[dist-epoch]更关注于实际任务的表现和最新数据，以评估模型的能力。

data.title: Genetic links with bipolar disorder identified
data.author: lentoutcry
data.article_summary: 一项迄今为止最大的双相情感障碍全基因组研究发现了298个与该疾病风险相关的基因组区域，比之前已知的遗传关联增加了四倍多。该研究首次包含了欧洲、东亚、非裔美国和拉丁裔人群的数据，并在一个东亚样本中发现了一个新的风险关联区域。通过多种方法交叉验证，研究团队确定了36个可能与双相情感障碍相关的基因。双相情感障碍影响全球约4000万至5000万人，通常需要八年时间才能确诊。研究团队希望通过理解这些基因，揭示疾病的生物学机制，并开发新的治疗方法。研究还发现，临床样本与自我报告样本中的遗传特征存在差异，表明需要注意数据收集策略。此外，研究显示该疾病的遗传信号与大脑特定细胞类型以及肠道和胰腺细胞有关。这项研究为未来开发更有效的治疗方法和精准医学奠定了基础。

43885091.article_content:
In the largest genome-wide study of bipolar disorder to date, an international team involving UCL researchers has identified 298 regions of the genome containing DNA variations that increase risk for the disorder.
The research published in
Nature
heralds a more than four-fold increase over the number of genetic links previously identified.
The study—the first large multi-ancestry genomic analysis of the disorder to include data from people of European, East Asian, African American, and Latino ancestries—also identifies a new region associated with an increased risk for the disorder within the East Asian samples. Cross-referencing a range of methods, including fine-mapping and other variant-to-gene-mapping approaches, the team identified 36 genes suspected to be relevant to bipolar disorder.
Bipolar disorder is an often lifelong mood disorder that impairs quality of life and functional ability, and is associated with suicide risk. It affects an estimated 40-50 million people worldwide.
There are two distinct subtypes: bipolar disorder type 1 is characterised by episodes of both mania and depression, while bipolar disorder type 2 includes episodes of hypomania (a less severe form of mania) and depression. Despite the prevalence of bipolar disorder, it can take an average of eight years to get a proper diagnosis, and much remains unknown about the biology of the condition.
To help elucidate bipolar disorder’s underlying biology, an international team of scientists from within the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium conducted a genome-wide association study, scanning the DNA of 2.9 million study participants from cohorts worldwide to identify genetic markers that were more common in those with the condition. This involved scanning more than 6.7 million common variations in the DNA sequences among the study participants, more than 158,000 of whom experience bipolar disorder.
Professor Andrew McQuillin (UCL Psychiatry), one of the senior authors of the paper, said: “Existing drug treatments for bipolar disorder provide much-needed support for many people, but they don’t work well enough for everyone, so there’s an ongoing need for new medications. We hope that by improving our understanding of which genes are linked to the disorder, we can improve our understand of how bipolar disorder works and potentially develop new treatments.”
Dr Niamh Mullins (Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, US), one of the senior authors of the paper, said: “It is well established that bipolar disorder has a substantial genetic basis, so identifying DNA variations that increase risk is of paramount importance to understanding the condition’s genetic architecture. In addition to identifying 298 regions of the genome that contain variations that increase risk for bipolar disorder, the 36 key genes we identified as being linked to the condition can now be followed up in a range of experiments to uncover the biological mechanisms through which each relates to the disorder.
“The newly identified genes may also be used in experiments to explore new drug targets and drug development for bipolar disorder.”
The study team also found differences in the genetic characteristics of bipolar disorder between clinical (patients recruited from hospital inpatient or outpatient units), community-based (participants in general population biobanks), and self-reporting (participants in online personal health surveys) participants. These genetic differences are likely to be driven by a higher prevalence of bipolar subtype 1 in the clinical samples versus a higher prevalence of bipolar subtype 2 in the self-reporting samples, which highlights the need for researchers to be mindful of the data-gathering strategies used within their studies of the condition.
According to the research team, the genetic signal of bipolar disorder is related to specific brain cell types, including GABAergic interneurons and medium spiny neurons, in the brain’s prefrontal cortex and hippocampus. They also found that cells in the intestine and pancreas are involved, although more research is necessary to further understand this biology.
Professor Ole Andreassen (University of Oslo), senior author of the paper, said: “Although this work does not immediately impact patient care, it opens the possibilities for long-term positive impact for patients and their families who are impacted by this widespread disorder. Our research paves the way for the development of improved treatments, earlier interventions, and precision medicine approaches that will support clinicians in their decision-making to enable them to manage the condition in the most effective way for each patient.”
The Psychiatric Genomics Consortium (PGC) is an international consortium of scientists dedicated to studying the genetic basis of psychiatric disorders and includes more than 1,700 researchers from over 65 countries.

data.title: Charles M. Lieber joins Tsinghua University
data.author: mnming
data.article_summary: 哈佛大学前化学系主任查尔斯·利伯（Charles Lieber）因未披露来自中国的资金支持被判有罪后，已加入中国清华大学深圳国际研究生院（SIGS），担任全职教授并被任命为讲席教授，这是该校最高的教师荣誉。利伯是纳米科学领域的先驱，他因隐瞒从中国机构获得的数百万美元研究资金而被定罪，但最终避免了入狱。清华大学表示，利伯的加入将推动材料科学和生物医学工程的发展，促进国内外研究团队的跨学科合作，并支持年轻学者的成长。利伯本人也表示，深圳的活力和创新精神与他的愿景完美契合。同时，曾在美国遭遇类似指控但后来被平反的物理学教授夏晓翔（Xiaoxing Xi）认为，利伯无法在美国继续工作，而中国将为他提供大量资金支持，这对中国而言是一个重大收获。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：哈佛大学一位科学家因隐瞒与中国的关系而被捕并受审，社区对此事件的反应和讨论。

不同观点：
• [对科学家的个人情感和支持] 一些评论者对该科学家表达了个人情感和支持。例如，badmonster提到曾阅读过该科学家的论文，并称其为纳米科学领域的传奇人物，祝愿他在未来一切顺利。

• [对司法系统和事件结果的质疑] buyucu认为这一事件是将人们投入监狱的结果，暗示对司法系统的处理方式不满，并表示希望该科学家能够找到快乐，祝他好运。

补充讨论：
• [事件背景的关注] 评论中通过链接指向了之前关于该事件的讨论线程，显示出社区对该科学家被捕和受审事件的持续关注。这些链接提供了更多背景信息，帮助理解当前评论的语境。

• [争议焦点] 争议的焦点可能在于对科学家被捕和审判的合理性，以及对个人在学术和国际关系复杂背景下的行为判断。部分评论者似乎对科学家表示同情，而对法律系统处理此类事件的方式持怀疑态度。

Harvard’s former chemistry chair takes new position at Chinese university
By
Rebecca Trager
2025-05-02T14:29:00+01:00
No comments
Charles Lieber, the former chair of Harvard University’s chemistry department who was convicted of failing to disclose significant Chinese funding, has
joined Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School (SIGS) in China.
Lieber took up a full-time position as a faculty member at the institute on 28 April.
Source: © Jonathan Wiggs/The Boston Globe/Getty Images
Nanoscience pioneer Charles Lieber was convicted on six counts of failing to report funding from Chinese institutions to his university or funder. He now joins Tsinghua University to continue his research
The nanoscience pioneer was
convicted of six criminal charges related to his receipt of millions of dollars in research funding from China
in December 2021. He had faced up to 26 years in prison and $1.2 million (£900,000) in fines but
avoided prison in April 2023
after being sentenced to time served. Lieber was on paid administrative leave from Harvard following his arrest until his retirement in February 2023.
SIGS has also appointed Lieber as a chair professor, which is the university’s highest faculty honour. The school’s vice president, Wang Hongwei, said that Lieber’s appointment ‘will significantly advance materials science and biomedical engineering development at Tsinghua University and Shenzhen, foster in-depth interdisciplinary collaborations between domestic and international research teams, and support the growth of young scholars into world-class scientists’.
The university’s dean, Ouyang Zheng, stated that Lieber’s participation at the university will ‘advance SIGS’s academic excellence and contribute to the establishment of a world-class scholarly community’.
Lieber said that ‘Shenzhen’s dynamism and innovative spirit’ align ‘perfectly’ with his vision to co-create a global scientific hub there.
Xiaoxing Xi
, a Chinese–American physics professor at Temple University who was arrested in 2015 and charged with spying but later vindicated when the US government
dropped its case against him
, says Lieber is an excellent catch for China. ‘Lieber is one of the brightest minds in nanotechnology, and now he cannot work in the United States,’ he tells
Chemistry World.
‘He is not going to be able to find any job in the United States, and now he finds this position in China, and it’s great for China.’
‘Everybody is worried about their funding being cut, or things like that, and I’m sure China is going to give Lieber tons of money, and I’m sure we’re going to see a lot of productivity out of Lieber’s lab,’ Xi adds. He says many scientists in the US, including himself, are nervous because of funding not being awarded and research grants cancelled. One of his grant proposals is up for renewal, and although it was reviewed back in November he says it is still pending.
‘Here in the United States, I have not been doing research as much as I used to, and I know many Chinese scientists who have not been working as much as they used to,’ Xi states. ‘There are all these disclosure rules and this and that, and anywhere if you make the mistake you could be in huge trouble – that’s very debilitating for me in doing my research.’
Update: Xiaoxing Xi’s comment was added on 2 May 2025.

43885163.article_summary: 哈佛大学前化学系主任查尔斯·利伯（Charles Lieber）因未披露来自中国的资金支持被判有罪后，已加入中国清华大学深圳国际研究生院（SIGS），担任全职教授并被任命为讲席教授，这是该校最高的教师荣誉。利伯是纳米科学领域的先驱，他因隐瞒从中国机构获得的数百万美元研究资金而被定罪，但最终避免了入狱。清华大学表示，利伯的加入将推动材料科学和生物医学工程的发展，促进国内外研究团队的跨学科合作，并支持年轻学者的成长。利伯本人也表示，深圳的活力和创新精神与他的愿景完美契合。同时，曾在美国遭遇类似指控但后来被平反的物理学教授夏晓翔（Xiaoxing Xi）认为，利伯无法在美国继续工作，而中国将为他提供大量资金支持，这对中国而言是一个重大收获。

data.author: punnerud
data.article_summary: 文章报道了一起全球性短信诈骗案。NRK记者通过监控诈骗团伙在Telegram上的聊天记录，揭露了一个庞大的国际诈骗网络。这些诈骗分子使用中文交流，隐藏在匿名身份后，通过发送欺骗性短信骗取钱财，受害者包括数千名挪威人。IT安全专家Erlend Leiknes及其同事意外发现了这个诈骗市场，看到大量被骗用户的信用卡信息和诈骗分子的奢侈品购买记录。诈骗团伙将受害者称为“鱼”，并分享诈骗策略和赃物，如奢侈鞋和电子产品。其中一名活跃分子x66常炫耀其诈骗所得，如价值不菲的奢侈品戒指。文章强调了诈骗活动的广泛性和危害性。

• 第三种观点：关注报告发布后的潜在风险。有评论者担心，此类详细的技术报告可能会被其他潜在攻击者用作学习工具，从而提高他们的攻击技巧和隐蔽性。这种观点强调了在公开披露此类信息时需要谨慎考虑其可能带来的负面影响。

• 争议的焦点在于报告发布的时机和动机。有人质疑Mnemonic选择此时发布报告是否出于特定目的，例如提升自身知名度，或者是否有其他未公开的考量。

通过这些观点和讨论，可以看出该报告引发了对网络安全威胁及其披露方式的广泛关注和思考。

A stream of text messages is being sent to mobile users across the globe.
The messages are crafted to deceive us.
The scammers never expected you to see this video.
NRK got hold of it from one of several scammer groups on the messaging app
Telegram
.
The scammers don't know that NRK has been monitoring them for a year. We've read over 40,000 chat messages between them to understand how the scam works.
The scammers have tricked millions of people worldwide, including thousands of Norwegians.
:
Does anybody know where this card is from?
:
:
Seems to be from Norway.
Who are they, really?
NORWEGIAN VERSION:
Read the Norwegian version of this story here.
x66
The members of the scam groups communicate in Chinese and hide behind cryptic usernames. One of the most active members goes by the name x667788x.
For simplicity, NRK refers to him as x66.
He uses a Chinese cartoon wolf as his profile picture.
x66 uses a Chinese cartoon wolf as his profile picture on Telegram.
x66 often boasts about how much money he has made by scamming others. In a picture he has shared, a diamond ring shaped like a venomous snake flashes on the left index finger.
The ring is from the Italian luxury brand Bulgari. If it's genuine, it has a list price of over 300,000 Norwegian kroner (NOK).
Even though x66 shares a lot on Telegram, there is one thing he is very careful about: never showing his face.
No one can know who he is.
But everyone makes mistakes.
The Scam Hunters
IT security expert Erlend Leiknes had no intention of becoming a scam hunter.
IT security expert Erlend Leiknes from the company Mnemonic.
Foto: Javier Ernesto Auris Chavez / NRK
Until this text message appeared on his mobile one day:
I
ivya.chanduedivy@icloud.com:
ivya.chanduedivy@icloud.com
The paackage has arrived at the warehouse but could not be delivered due to incomplete address information. Please confirm your address using the link.
https://postens2no.shop
/NO/
There was a lot that seemed off: the spelling mistake, the sender's contact info, and the strange url embedded in the message.
Leiknes recognized this as phishing — a scam method where culprits fish for sensitive information in order to steal someone's identity or money.
But who was trying to reel him in?
He sat down with his American colleague Harrison Sand. Both work at the company Mnemonic, a cyber security service provider, based in Oslo.
Erlend Leiknes and Harrison Sand working at Mnemonic.
Foto: Javier Ernesto Auris Chavez / NRK
They decided to try to sneak up on the person behind the text message.
They clicked on the link to analyze the scam website. They found a loophole in the site's code that allowed them to see what was going on behind the scenes.
What they discovered left them astonished.
The Fish Market
Hundreds of names, addresses, and bank card details scrolled across the screen. Many of them were Norwegian.
The data experts had accessed the scammer's hub.
And perhaps the most striking part was: They were now watching as people entered their card details.
These were people who, at that very moment, were taking the bait.
I was shocked by how many victims there were.
Erlend Leiknes
Scam hunter
The data experts investigated further and gained access to a closed group on Telegram.
A new world unfolded.
The group had several hundred members that shared videos of mobile phones sending out deceptive text messages. They also showcased card terminals to charge the stolen cards, and images of luxury goods they purchased. The data experts had discovered a marketplace for phishing activities.
Essentially, the scammers' fish market.
A scammer posted a picture of several pairs of shoes that appear to be from the luxury brand Valentino.
A scammer uploads an image of multiple card terminals. The scammers drain bank cards on such terminals.
Several boxes that appear to contain iPhones are shared in the scam group. These are used to send out scam messages or to load stolen cards into digital wallets.
A scammer displays a stack of American hundred-dollar bills.
In the group, members also discussed strategies for scamming as many people as possible. They referred to those who got fooled as
«
fish
»
and shared where the fish were biting now.
One of the most active members was the one who goes by the name x66.
Below is an excerpt from a typical dialogue:
x66:
Thailand is a great place for fishing.
:
I sent out 20 to 30,000 text messages today.
:
Where there's a lot of fish, there's a lot of money.
How many of us have they deceived?

data.title: An Alabama landline that keeps ringing
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary:
《阿拉巴马州的固定电话依旧响铃》  
作者：Emily McCrary  
2025年4月23日

在奥本大学的Foy信息台，自1953年以来，这个电话服务一直为公众开放。学生们轮流值班，接听各种奇怪的问题，如法律、电子游戏甚至超自然现象。尽管时代变迁，信息台从过去的参考书堆变成了现在的iMac电脑，但电话号码始终未变：(334) 844-4244。

每天，学生们要接听各类问题，从药物用途到房产价格，甚至是恶作剧电话。对于全球一些无法或不愿使用互联网的人来说，这些学生就像“人肉搜索引擎”。员工手册简单，主要规则是保持礼貌，遇到冒犯性问题可挂断电话。

晚上九点后，信息台变得安静，但像Beulah这样的常客会打来长电话，聊她的宠物和生活中的小麻烦。尽管她的背景成谜，学生们依然耐心倾听。这个电话服务已成为连接不同人群的独特桥梁。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于奥本大学Foy咨询台的历史、功能及与现代信息获取方式的对比

不同观点：
• 一些评论者分享了他们在2000年代初期作为志愿者或学生使用Foy咨询台的个人经历。例如，RebeccaTheDev提到当时学生经常询问课程时间或地点，而有些学生因为缺乏计算机技能或设备，不得不依赖人工服务（如Foy咨询台）获取信息。
• dabluecaboose则提到在2010年代初，智能手机互联网尚不发达，学生们仍通过Foy咨询台解决争论。

• 另一部分评论者讨论了Foy咨询台与现代信息获取方式的对比。masto认为从人工查询到搜索引擎查询是信息获取的“巅峰”，而现在由于垃圾信息和生成式AI的泛滥，信息质量正在下降。这个观点引发了对未来信息获取方式的思考，认为未来可能需要重新依赖人工帮助或图书馆。

• 另有一些评论将Foy咨询台与历史上其他类似的服务（如NY公共图书馆服务、RPI的类似系统）进行类比，讨论这些服务在现代技术环境下的命运。AbstractH24好奇Foy咨询台如何适应LLM（大语言模型）时代，而delichon则用幽默的方式指出某些职业或服务（如电梯操作员、煤炭锅炉工）在技术进步中逐渐消失的现象。

• trollbridge提到与Foy咨询台类似的800-GOOG-411服务仅运行了三年就被关闭，对比之下突显了Foy咨询台的长久运营。

补充讨论：
• brudgers分享了关于Foy咨询台命名由来的人物Jim “Dean Foy” Foy的详细背景故事，增加了对该服务历史意义的理解。
• 一些评论者表达了对Foy咨询台及其所代表的时代的情感，如Mistletoe认为保留一些“古旧”的事物（如老式电话）能为世界增添一丝奇妙感。
• 最后，ForOldHack和LadyCailin等评论者以个人经历或幽默的方式表达了对现代技术与过去服务方式差异的看法，强调了对这些古老服务的怀旧情感。

争议焦点：
• 主要集中在现代信息获取方式（如搜索引擎、AI）是否真的优于传统人工服务。masto认为过去的人工查询是信息获取的巅峰，而现代技术环境下的信息质量正在下降，这一观点与其他评论者对现代技术便利性的默认接受形成对比。

The Alabama Landline That Keeps Ringing
Auburn University’s help desk is still answering the public’s calls 70 years on
By Emily McCrary
April 23, 2025
Foy Information Desk at Auburn University, Photo by Emily McCrary
I
f you sit at the James E. Foy Information Desk in the Melton Student Center at Auburn University, answering the phones on a Wednesday night, you might be responsible for answering a question like this: “If you died on the operating table and they declared you legally dead and wrote out a death certificate and everything, but then you came back to life, what are the legal ramifications? Do you technically no longer exist? Do you have to be declared undead by a judge?”
A little later, the phone will ring again, and the caller might ask, “Who is the most famous person in the world?” Your next question: “How do you get the Super Serum in Call of Duty?” And finally, when you pick up the phone close to eleven o’clock, quitting time, you might hear someone blow a giant raspberry then hang up.
I spent the better part of two days and nights listening to students answer questions at the Foy desk, where phones have been ringing since 1953, when James E. Foy, Auburn’s then dean of students, opened the line as a resource for students and then as a service to the public. For just as long, students who sit there have been answering any question asked of them—or at least tried their best.
By nine o’clock, the student center is quiet. That’s when people like Beulah call.
T
he desk looks different today than it did seventy years ago. For starters, it’s in an expensive
, modern-looking student center. The old Foy Hall still exists, and now houses a few small student-engagement offices; but it’s got low ceilings and could use an update. There used to be stacks of books at the desk—encyclopedias and dictionaries, reference texts, phone books, the
Farmers’ Almanac
, the
Guinness Book of World Records
, and Emily Post’s
Etiquette
—but they’ve been replaced by three desktop iMacs, the really nice ones, whose backs are blue and orange, like the school’s colors. As for the phone number, that’s still the same: (334) 844-4244.
A day’s worth of calls to Foy would look a lot like someone’s browser history: What is cefuroxime prescribed for? What’s the average cost of an acre of land in Texas? What’s the cheapest property in New Jersey? How much is Elon Musk worth? What’s the customer service phone number for Costco? How much is a ticket to the Super Bowl? What is watercress? What is that weird smell? Are AirPods Pro 2 waterproof? What do I do if there’s a snake in my house? What are all the names for female genitals? (Foy student workers won’t respond to that last question, but that doesn’t stop callers from asking it.
)
About
13 million people in the US
and
2.6 billion people globally
don’t use the internet, whether for reasons of availability, desire, cost, or religion. Some may have it but don’t feel confident using it. To their callers, who dial from all over the world, these students are the internet. And lucky for callers, these students are remarkably non-judgmental when it comes to the questions they’re asked.
The employee manual for the Foy desk is ten sheets of 8.5x11, with instructions on how to clock in and out and pick up shifts. Training for the phones is minimal. More or less, the rules are these: Be as polite as possible, end the call if the question is offensive, don’t answer anything that sounds like a homework question, and if someone makes a threat, hang up and dial *57 (that helps the police trace the call), then tell your supervisor.
During the day, the phones ring about ten to fifteen times an hour. Most of the calls are from the general public. Occasionally, an Auburn student calls to ask about basketball tickets or whether their brown jacket ended up in the lost and found. As classes wrap up for the afternoon and the sun sets, the big windows that filter sunlight turn into mirrors. Calls become less frequent, so students working at the desk settle into their homework. It’s a perk of the job. By nine o’clock, the student center is quiet. That’s when people like Beulah call.
Foy student workers have exceptional manners, and they don’t go poking around in someone else’s business.
B
eulah has a lot of pets and an affinity for bearded dragons. She seems to attract wild animals too: There’s been a fox in her yard, a snake in her house, a spider on her curtains. She’s called to ask for the phone number for an exterminator more than once. While most callers are off the line in less than two minutes, Beulah’s calls last at least fifteen. But who she is, the students hardly know. Accents are sometimes a giveaway, but hers isn’t Southern, nor is it apparently from the Northeast, where her area code suggests she lives. 每天，学生们要接听各类问题，从药物用途到房产价格，甚至是恶作剧电话。对于全球一些无法或不愿使用互联网的人来说，这些学生就像“人肉搜索引擎”。员工手册简单，主要规则是保持礼貌，遇到冒犯性问题可挂断电话。

晚上九点后，信息台变得安静，但像Beulah这样的常客会打来长电话，聊她的宠物和生活中的小麻烦。尽管她的背景成谜，学生们依然耐心倾听。这个电话服务已成为连接不同人群的独特桥梁。

data.article_summary: Oberon Pi 是 Richard Gleaves 将 Peter de Wachter 的 Oberon 系统模拟器移植到 Raspberry Pi OS 的版本。Gleaves 是前 UCSD Pascal 项目成员，并撰写了《Modula-2 for Pascal Programmers》一书。Oberon Pi 主要改进了用户界面，简化了新用户的学习曲线，同时保留了 Oberon 系统的核心特性。它还集成了 Andreas Pirklbauer 对 Oberon 编译器的修改，完全实现了 CASE 语句并修复了一些编译器错误。该项目提供了全面的文档和指南，包括新的用户指南和原始 Oberon 文档，并可在 Raspberry Pi 400 上运行。为在 64 位系统上运行，需对设置进行一些调整。所有资源可在 GitHub 上获取。

43885478.article_content:
Oberon, the jewel by Niklaus Wirth and Jürg Gutknecht: Operating System, Compiler and Computer.
Oberon Pi is a port of Peter de Wachter’s Project Oberon emulator to the Raspberry Pi OS by Richard Gleaves.
Richard Gleaves is a former UCSD Pascal Project member, and author of the 1984 Springer book “Modula-2 for Pascal Programmers”.
The software changes were mostly limited to the UI, with the goal of flattening out the learning curve for new users of the Oberon system, not only read about in a few places online, but also experienced firsthand after bringing the system up.
Richard also added
Andreas Pirklbauer
’s changes to the Oberon compiler, to fully implement CASE statements and fix a few compiler bugs.
The main feature in Oberon Pi is its documentation, which includes new user guides Richard wrote for the Oberon operating system and draw application, along with a complete set of Wirth’s original PDF documents on the Oberon language, now made more usable with the addition of TOCs to the PDFs.
Here an uptodate downloadable list of relevant Oberon documents:
Oberon – The Overlooked Jewel, Michael Franz
Compiler Construction, 2017, Niklaus Wirth
Differences between Revised Oberon and Oberon, 2008, Niklaus Wirth
The Programming Language Oberon, 2013/2026
Programming A Tutorial, 1982/2015, Niklaus Wirth
A Plea for Lean Software, Niklaus Wirth
Project Oberon
The Design of an Operating System, a Compiler and a Computer
Revised Edition 2013
Niklaus Wirth, Jurg Gutknecht
Oberon Pi Setup Guide
Oberon Pi Quick Reference
Oberon Pi System User Guide
Oberon Pi Draw Quick Reference
Oberon Pi Draw User Guide
See the github at
https://github.com/richardgleaves/Oberon-Pi
for Oberon Pi, ready to run on the Raspberry Pi OS.
See below how to run Oberon Pi on a 64 bit architecture Raspberry Pi OS.
Oberon Pi
Author
: Richard Gleaves
This version of Oberon, named Oberon Pi, emulates the Oberon system on a Raspberry Pi 400, using the Raspberry Pi OS as the host operating system.
Oberon Pi runs as an application in the Raspberry Pi OS. When you execute the Oberon Pi command, a window opens on the Pi OS desktop. This window is the Oberon *display*, and it works like a separate computer running the Oberon system, with its own windows, command menus, and file system.
Goals
The original Oberon system includes many unusual user interface elements. These elements make the system worthy of study, both as a historical software artifact, and as a case study in user interface design.
But the original system also includes a few non-key features (such as *mouse interclicking* and opaque command names) which make the system difficult to learn.
The primary goal and purpose of Oberon Pi is instructional: to make the original Oberon system more accessible, by updating the non-key user interface elements to contemporary software standards, while preserving the key elements that make Oberon unique.
Oberon Pi includes source code and full documentation of the Oberon system and language. The system user guide is provided as both a standalone PDF file and as integrated help in the Oberon system.
System Requirements
–  Raspberry Pi computer (Pi4 or Pi 5 preferred)
–  32 bit or 64 bit Raspberry Pi OS desktop vrsion(Bookworm or Bullseye)
–  Desktop computer monitor (large preferred)
Installation
For details see the *Oberon Pi Setup Guide*.
History
The Oberon system was originally developed in the late 1980s by Niklaus Wirth and Jürg Gutknecht. In 2013 the system was re-implemented by Wirth and Paul Reed to run on a custom RISC processor. In 2014 an emulator for the RISC processor was developed by Peter De Wachter. Oberon Pi is a port of the emulator to the Raspberry Pi OS.
Install and run on 64 bit Raspberry Pi OS
The github distribution is for the 32 bit Raspberry Pi OS.
Make these changes to run Oberon Pi on a 64 bit Raspberry Pi OS after the initial setup but before launching Oberon Pi:
cd Oberon\Emulator
mv risc risc.pi400
sudo apt install libsdl2-dev
make
which will produce (silently) a new ‘risc’ executable and follow the ‘Oberon Pi Setup Guide’.
Here an archive with both 32 bit and 64 bit ‘risc’ executables.

data.title: Show HN: I taught AI to commentate Pong in real time
data.author: pncnmnp
data.article_summary: "xPong" 是一个经典游戏 Pong 的变种，集成了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的实时解说功能。该项目利用 OpenAI 的 gpt-4o-mini-tts 技术，实现了近实时的游戏解说。游戏包含一个模拟15年赛事的锦标赛，每年有四场大型赛事，通过 Elo 等级分模拟玩家和比赛。在第16年，全球排名前两位的玩家将在世界锦标赛决赛中对决。游戏中的解说分为开场、逐球解说和闭幕解说三层，由两名评论员交替发言。解说逻辑基于事件驱动，重要事件会打断解说，之后再继续。游戏还通过最近邻搜索对比历史数据提供深度分析。项目使用 MIT 许可证，音效来自 SoundReality 和 OpenAI 的资源。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI生成评论在Pong游戏中的应用及其潜在扩展

不同观点：
• [mtlynch] 认为Pong游戏过于简单，AI评论缺乏挑战性，预编程即可实现。并质疑该技术能否应用于更复杂的游戏如象棋或德州扑克，以增加评论的深度和趣味性。
• [blakeburch] 支持该想法，并建议将其应用于如《英雄联盟》或《火箭联盟》等电竞项目，认为这可以提升观赛体验。
• [indigodaddy] 提出替代评论的想法，特别是对“对视竞赛”这样的活动，建议使用幽默、干涩的评论风格。
• [QRe] 指出由于脚本生成和文本转语音（TTS）的延迟，评论可能跟不上快节奏游戏的步伐，特别是在体育类游戏中。
• [croemer] 分享了视频中更精彩的部分，以跳过无聊的赛前谈话，认为这样能提升体验。
• [petercooper] 希望在工作时也能有类似的评论，特别是对自己编程工作的幽默调侃，认为这可以增加趣味性。
• [jart] 提到主流游戏如John Madden是否已有类似功能，认为这是LLM（大语言模型）的良好应用场景。
• [neilv] 质疑生成评论的真实性，担心评论内容是否会纯属虚构。
• [hvardhan878] 建议模仿著名解说员Peter Drury的语调和情感，甚至让Pong游戏变得情感化。
• [smus] 认为该项目本质上只是API调用的组合，算不上真正的“教学”AI。
• [sim7c00] 觉得视频开头较枯燥，但游戏开始后非常有趣，体验令人兴奋。
• [danjl] 对圆形球体提出疑问，可能对游戏画面或物理效果有不同看法。
• [ayongpm] 认为AI评论能增加Pong游戏的趣味性，并建议举办职业Pong比赛以提升游戏的地位。
• [isaacremuant] 肯定了该想法的趣味性，但认为评论内容缺乏深度，建议增加更多的实时解说，减少无关填充内容，并提出通过外部事件接收和生成评论以减少延迟。

补充讨论：
- 评论延迟和如何减少延迟是多个评论者关注的焦点，尤其是对于快节奏游戏。
- 不同游戏的复杂性和适用性被广泛讨论，特别是象棋、德州扑克和电竞项目。
- 评论的真实性和深度受到质疑，部分评论者担心生成内容可能失实或缺乏相关性。

xPong
As the name suggests,
xPong
is all about Pong — but with a twist: there’s LLM-based commentary generation integrated into the game.
I’ve wanted to do this for the longest time — in fact, back in my undergrad days,
I used to carry around a GitHub Gist to store such ideas, and an entry for this one dates back to Feb 16 2020.
That’s five years!
Anyway, for the longest time we never had the right technology to pull this off in a cost-effective, near-realtime manner.
However, late last month, with
OpenAI’s
gpt-4o-mini-tts
, we finally have the resources to do it!
I envision a future where
gpt-4o-mini-tts
-like software is integrated on the edge.
When that happens, next-generation gaming consoles will leverage such technology, opening up a whole universe of possibilities in gaming, especially in sports-simulation titles.
Hope you have a blast tinkering with this game and its source code!
Demo
Installation
Before installing the dependencies, I encourage you to
create and activate a virtual environment
- for example, run
python3 -m venv .venv
and then
source .venv/bin/activate
on macos/linux.
To install the Python dependencies, use:
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
Next, create an API key in OpenAI’s dashboard.
For this, follow the steps in OpenAI’s
Create and export an API key
docs.
Once you have the key, store it in a
.env
file at the root of this repository:
OPENAI_API_KEY
=
your-api-key
Because this code leverages an Electron-like library
Eel
, you will also need a
Chromium-based browser
.
When everything is set up, run:
python3 main.py
Add
--cache
to cache LLM-generated player metadata for later runs, and
--no-opening
to skip the opening commentary.
What’s in it?
It’s packed with ideas!
There’s a tournament simulator that simulates 15 years' worth of tournaments. Each year includes four majors — sixty events in all. Players and matches are simulated using
Elo
.
In the
16th year
, when the main match starts, the world’s top two players face off in the World Championship Final.
Two AIs are playing against each other in a game of Pong, with variations in their reaction times and shot speeds.
The commentary logic has
three layers
- opening commentary with a scorecard, in-game ball-by-ball commentary, and closing commentary.
Two commentators take turns talking to each other and the audience.
Commentary is interrupted when an important in-game event occurs, then resumes from where it left off afterward.
In-game commentary is driven by an
event-based pipeline
: actions are logged as events, periodically parsed into metrics,
those metrics are ranked by priority to decide which deserve mention next, and the resulting text is fed through TTS.
With 15 years of historical data, the game uses
nearest-neighbor search
to find similar past games and share insights.
It even goofs around - comparing the current playing style to past legends and sprinkling in a few locker-room whispers.
License and acknowledgements
This code is licensed under the
MIT License
.
The paddle-hitting sound was generated using SoundReality's
"Tennis Ball Hit"
sound.
It is licensed under Pixabay's
"Content License"
.
The filler sounds were generated with
https://www.openai.fm/
and abide by OpenAI's
terms and policies
.

43872159.article_summary: "xPong" 是一个经典游戏 Pong 的变种，集成了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的实时解说功能。该项目利用 OpenAI 的 gpt-4o-mini-tts 技术，实现了近实时的游戏解说。游戏包含一个模拟15年赛事的锦标赛，每年有四场大型赛事，通过 Elo 等级分模拟玩家和比赛。在第16年，全球排名前两位的玩家将在世界锦标赛决赛中对决。游戏中的解说分为开场、逐球解说和闭幕解说三层，由两名评论员交替发言。解说逻辑基于事件驱动，重要事件会打断解说，之后再继续。游戏还通过最近邻搜索对比历史数据提供深度分析。项目使用 MIT 许可证，音效来自 SoundReality 和 OpenAI 的资源。

data.title: A visual feast of galaxies, from infrared to X-ray
data.author: giuliomagnifico
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了NASA/ESA/CSA詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜拍摄的一组壮观的星系图像，结合了红外和X射线数据。左侧图像显示了大量星系，其中一些距离我们数十亿光年；右侧图像则展示了炽热气体发出的X射线（蓝色光晕）。这些星系属于COSMOS-Web项目的研究范围，该项目旨在探索宇宙中大规模结构的形成，尤其是星系群如何演化和连接成星系团。韦伯望远镜的红外能力使得探测可以追溯到宇宙仅19亿年时的星系群。图像展示了不同形状、颜色和距离的星系，反映了它们的多样性和演化历史。COSMOS-Web计划还旨在研究宇宙再电离时期以及星系与其外围晕的关系演变。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对宇宙和光波的感知与解释

不同观点：
• [HocusLocus的观点] 认为宇宙是一个 vibrating universe，其中存在超越常规感知的联系，如颜色和声音的交织。HocusLocus 描述了一种理想状态，即通过感知超声波、紫外线、红外线和X射线等不可见光波，人类可以体验到更广泛的美丽。他引用了"OM"这个词，似乎是在强调一种宇宙的整体和谐与统一，表达了一种超越物理感知的灵性理解。

• [PaulHoule的观点] 则从科学角度解释了宇宙中的光波现象，特别是红外线的感知。PaulHoule 提到了将红外强度转换为可见颜色 (r,g,b) 的技术方法，并引用了天文学资料来解释遥远星系为何看起来更红，这是因为气体加热到极高温度所致。这表明 PaulHoule 更关注于从物理学和天文学角度理解宇宙现象，强调了科学解释而非灵性或感知体验。

补充讨论：
• HocusLocus 的评论带有一种诗意和哲学意味，试图通过感官之间的交错来描述宇宙的复杂性，并且强调了人类感知的局限性以及通过灵性词汇（如"OM"）理解宇宙的可能性。
  
• PaulHoule 的评论则带有明显的科学分析色彩，引用了具体的天文学资料，讨论了星系颜色变化的物理原因，关注于如何通过技术手段将不可见光波转化为人类可以理解的视觉信息。

• 争议的焦点在于如何理解和解释宇宙现象：是通过科学实证的方式，还是通过感知和灵性体验的方式。这反映了科学与灵性在理解宇宙本质上的不同路径。

On the
left
, the new
Picture of the Month
from the NASA/ESA/CSA
James Webb Space Telescope
features an astounding number of galaxies. On the right, as a blue glow, we see also the X-ray light coming from the blazing hot gas that fills the space between the galaxies.
The objects in this frame span an incredible range of distances, from stars within our own Milky Way, marked by diffraction spikes, to galaxies billions of light-years away. The focus of this image is a group of galaxies, the largest concentration of which can be found just below the centre of this image. These galaxies glow with white-gold light. We see this galaxy group as it appeared when the Universe was 6.5 billion years old, a little less than half the Universe’s current age.
The galaxy group pictured here is the most massive group in what’s called the COSMOS-Web field. COSMOS stands for Cosmic Evolution Survey. This survey has enlisted several telescopes, including Webb, the NASA/ESA
Hubble Space Telescope
, and ESA’s
XMM-Newton
space observatory to gaze deeply at a single patch of sky.
COSMOS-Web aims to understand how massive structures like galaxy clusters came to be. More than half of the galaxies in our Universe belong to galaxy groups like the one pictured here. Studying galaxy groups is critical for understanding how individual galaxies link up to form galaxy clusters, the largest gravitationally bound structures in the Universe. Belonging to a galaxy group can also alter the course of a galaxy’s evolution through mergers and gravitational interactions.
Webb’s infrared capabilities and sensitive instruments have pushed the search for galaxy groups farther back into cosmic history, revealing galaxy groups as far back as when the Universe was only 1.9 billion years old – just 14% of its current age.
The image on the left combines infrared data from Webb’s
Near-InfraRed Camera
(NIRCam) instrument with further infrared observations from Hubble. On the right, the X-ray data, shown in purple, highlights the presence of hot gas concentrated within the
X-ray galaxy group
. These X-ray data come from XMM-Newton, with contributions from NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory.
This image presents a visual feast of galaxies. Take a moment to examine the galactic buffet: you’ll see galaxies with delicate spiral arms or warped disks, galaxies with smooth, featureless faces, and even galaxies that are interacting or merging and have taken on an array of strange shapes.
The range of colours is also fascinating, representing both galaxies with different ages of stars – younger stars appear bluer, and older stars appear redder – as well as galaxies at different distances. The more distant a galaxy, the redder it appears.
COSMOS-Web is a 255-hour Webb Treasury programme that maps 0.54 square degrees (a little more than two-and-a-half times the area covered by three full moons) of the COSMOS field using four NIRCam filters. Treasury programmes have the potential to answer multiple important questions about our Universe.
COSMOS-Web has three key goals: to identify galaxies during
the epoch of reionisation
, when the first stars and galaxies reionised the Universe’s hydrogen gas; to probe the formation of the Universe’s most massive galaxies; and to understand how the relationship between the mass of a galaxy’s stars and the mass of its extended galactic halo evolves over the course of cosmic history.

Image Description:
An area of deep space with thousands of galaxies in various shapes and sizes on a black background. A few gold-coloured galaxies are bunched closely together in the centre. A large, translucent purple cloud lies over the galaxies, thickest across the centre where the gold galaxies sit, and fainter up to the right. This shows where X-rays are emitted by hot gas in the group of galaxies.]

data.title: Evidence of controversial Planet 9 uncovered in sky surveys taken 23 years apart
data.author: spchampion2
data.article_summary:
文章主要讨论了假设中的太阳系行星——第九行星（Planet Nine），该行星最早于2014年被提出，但尚未被正式探测到。天文学家通过一些跨海王星天体（TNOs）的轨道扰动推测其存在。第九行星估计半径是地球的2到4倍，质量约为地球的十倍。2016年，加州理工学院的Michael Brown和Konstantin Batygin提出这一假设，以解释柯伊伯带天体轨道异常聚集的现象。

最近，台湾国立清华大学的天文学家Terry Long Phan团队分析了两次相隔23年的深空红外线观测数据，发现了一个可能的候选对象。该团队使用了1983年IRAS卫星和2006年JAXA的AKARI卫星的数据，通过排除视差效应和快速移动天体，找到了一颗可能的距离太阳约700天文单位的行星。然而，这一发现仍需进一步验证。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕“第九行星”（Planet 9）的讨论，包括其距离描述、性质假设、观测证据及命名争议。

不同观点：
• 关于距离描述的意义：AIPedant认为用“比冥王星距离太阳远15倍”来描述比“比地球距离太阳远700倍”更能让普通读者理解，强调描述方式的选择对公众理解的影响。
• 关于第九行星的性质：randomtoast提出一种有趣的理论，认为第九行星可能是一个史瓦西半径只有几厘米的原初黑洞，类似于高尔夫球大小，这可以解释为什么我们只能看到引力效应而没有直接观测到该天体。K0balt对此表示支持，并表示希望这一理论成真，因为这将非常“酷”且有用。
• 关于观测证据的争议：perihelions指出某些观测结果与Batygin和Brown提出的第九行星假设不符，特别是轨道倾角的差异。
• 关于命名争议：rootsudo质疑“行星X”变为“行星9”是由于冥王星从行星行列中被除名所致。_heimdall则情感上坚持认为冥王星应继续被视为第九行星，不管科学界如何重新定义。metalman同样提到了冥王星被降级的事件，并暗示未来可能会有变化，甚至提出了“让冥王星再次成为行星”（MPAPA）的调侃。

补充讨论：
• 关于观测图像质量的质疑：vpribish对不同天文图像中的一致性提出质疑，指出在IRAS图像中能看到亮点，但在AKARI图像中却看不到。
• 其他幽默和调侃：astar1幽默地称其为“质量中继站”（Mass Relay），ForOldHack则坚决否认其行星地位，tiahura提出对其他星系行星观测能力的疑问，doublerabbit则借题发挥表达对当前生活环境的不满，Nimitz14的评论被标记为需要注意。

争议焦点：
• 第九行星是否存在及其具体性质，特别是其是否为原初黑洞的假设。
• 冥王星是否应被视为第九行星的命名争议。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 不同读者对距离描述的理解问题。
• 观测图像的一致性和准确性问题。
• 对行星命名和分类的公众情感反应。

43874641.article_content:
Planet Nine is a hypothesized massive planet, first proposed in 2014, that is speculated to orbit far out in the solar system. It has not been detected formally. Instead, astronomers have inferred its presence from perceived perturbations of the orbits of some Trans-Neptunian Objects (TNOs). The planet is estimated to be 2 to 4 times the radius, and about ten times the mass of the Earth.
(Image credit: Mark Garlick/Science Photo Library/Getty Images)
The best candidate yet for the elusive Planet Nine has been spotted in two deep infrared surveys taken 23 years apart. If this mystery object really is Planet Nine, it would have a mass greater than Neptune, and currently be about 700 times farther from the sun than Earth is.
The possibility of additional planets in our
solar system
has been proposed many times, going under names such as "Planet X," because experts thought the concept of an extra planet in our vicinity of the cosmos could explain a perceived regularity in mass extinctions on Earth. Perhaps, they said, the periodic influx of
comets
that impact Earth are pushed our way by an unseen planet. However, the supposed periodicity in mass extinctions has not held up to scrutiny, and so the need for that particular Planet X has gone away. This brings us to Planet Nine.
Planet Nine
is unrelated to the Planet X concept, and rather put forward in 2016 by Michael Brown and Konstantin Batygin of the California Institute of Technology to explain an unusual bunching of orbits of some objects in the
Kuiper Belt
, such as Sedna. This proposed Planet Nine would be more massive than
Earth
, and orbit on a highly eccentric path that takes it hundreds of
astronomical units
from the
sun
(one astronomical unit is the distance between Earth and the sun). That far away, it would be extremely difficult to detect.
However, the expectation is that Planet Nine would appear brighter in mid- and far-infrared light than it would in visible light.

Now, a team led by astronomer Terry Long Phan of the National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan has delved into the archives of two far-infrared all-sky surveys in search of Planet Nine — and incredibly, they have found something that could possibly be Planet Nine.
The Infrared Astronomy Satellite, IRAS, launched in 1983 and surveyed the
universe
for almost a year before being decommissioned. Then, in 2006, the Japanese Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) launched AKARI, another infrared astronomy satellite that was active between 2006 and 2011.
Phan's team were looking for objects that appeared in IRAS's database, then appeared to have moved by the time AKARI took a look. The amount of movement on the sky would be tiny — about three arcminutes per year at a distance of approximately 700 astronomical units (AU). One arcminute is 1/60 of an angular degree.

But there's an extra motion that Phan's team had to account for. As the Earth orbits the sun, our view of the position of very distant objects changes slightly in an effect called
parallax
. It is the same phenomenon as when you hold your index finger up to your face, close one eye and look at your finger, and then switch eyes — your finger appears to move as a result of you looking at it from a slightly different position.
Planet Nine would appear to move on the sky because of parallax as Earth moves around the sun. On any particular day, it might seem to be in one position, then six months later when Earth is on the other side of the sun, it would shift to another position, perhaps by 10 to 15 arcminutes — then, six months after that, it would seem to shift back to its original position. To remove the effects of parallax, Phan's team searched for Planet Nine on the same date every year in the AKARI data, because on any given date it would appear in the same place, with zero parallax shift, every year.
They then also scrutinized each candidate object that their search threw up on an hourly basis. If a candidate is a fast-moving, nearby object, then its motion would be detectable from hour to hour, and could therefore be ruled out.
This careful search led Phan's team to a single object, a tiny dot in the infrared data.
A comparison of the position of the candidate object in the IRAS data (left) and the AKARI data (right) and the distance in arcminutes between them.
(Image credit: Phan et al (2025))

• 关于距离描述的意义：AIPedant认为用“比冥王星距离太阳远15倍”来描述比“比地球距离太阳远700倍”更能让普通读者理解，强调描述方式的选择对公众理解的影响。
• 关于第九行星的性质：randomtoast提出一种有趣的理论，认为第九行星可能是一个史瓦西半径只有几厘米的原初黑洞，类似于高尔夫球大小，这可以解释为什么我们只能看到引力效应而没有直接观测到该天体。K0balt对此表示支持，并表示希望这一理论成真，因为这将非常“酷”且有用。
• 关于观测证据的争议：perihelions指出某些观测结果与Batygin和Brown提出的第九行星假设不符，特别是轨道倾角的差异。
• 关于命名争议：rootsudo质疑“行星X”变为“行星9”是由于冥王星从行星行列中被除名所致。_heimdall则情感上坚持认为冥王星应继续被视为第九行星，不管科学界如何重新定义。metalman同样提到了冥王星被降级的事件，并暗示未来可能会有变化，甚至提出了“让冥王星再次成为行星”（MPAPA）的调侃。

补充讨论：
• 关于观测图像质量的质疑：vpribish对不同天文图像中的一致性提出质疑，指出在IRAS图像中能看到亮点，但在AKARI图像中却看不到。
• 其他幽默和调侃：astar1幽默地称其为“质量中继站”（Mass Relay），ForOldHack则坚决否认其行星地位，tiahura提出对其他星系行星观测能力的疑问，doublerabbit则借题发挥表达对当前生活环境的不满，Nimitz14的评论被标记为需要注意。

争议焦点：
• 第九行星是否存在及其具体性质，特别是其是否为原初黑洞的假设。
• 冥王星是否应被视为第九行星的命名争议。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 不同读者对距离描述的理解问题。
• 观测图像的一致性和准确性问题。
• 对行星命名和分类的公众情感反应。

data.title: Minimum Viable Blog
data.author: jlundberg
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了作者如何创建一个简易博客，满足特定需求：使用已有域名、遵循现代网页标准、具备良好的SEO、易于添加新内容以及所有页面均为静态。作者选择不使用Jekyll、Ghost或WordPress等平台，而是手动编写了一个简单的解决方案。他创建了一个`template.html`文件，并使用Python脚本`render.py`将Markdown文件转换为HTML页面。脚本会读取指定目录中的Markdown文件，将其内容转换为HTML并插入到模板中，生成静态页面。同时，脚本还会生成一个包含所有博客文章链接的索引页。最终，作者成功搭建了一个简易但功能齐全的博客。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：个人博客搭建的技术选择与取舍，包括静态网站生成器（SSG）、内容管理系统（CMS）、自定义系统等的优缺点，以及相关功能（如RSS feed、日期排序、评论系统等）的实现。

不同观点：
• Tallain认为使用SSG（静态网站生成器）容易陷入技术细节，而忽视了原本的写作目标。他最终选择WordPress，以避免分心，专注于写作本身。
• p4bl0强调博客应具备按日期排序的帖子和RSS feed，这是博客的基本功能，易于通过脚本实现。
• susam分享了自己从ASP到Common Lisp的博客演变过程，逐步添加了RSS feed、按日期排序、标签等功能，但保持代码简洁，避免过度复杂化。
• nicbou支持使用Jekyll和GitHub Pages，认为这是将文本文件转换为网站的低 effort 方式，但也指出静态文件网站在维护旧URL和添加动态功能方面的挑战。
• KronisLV选择使用Grav CMS，结合Git和Docker，实现了文件版本控制和动态模板功能，同时保持了静态文件的简单性。
• captn3m0希望浏览器原生支持Markdown和Gemini格式，以降低发布门槛，并增强用户对内容展示的控制。
• pvtmert使用Git子模块管理依赖，构建了一个全静态的自定义博客系统，直接在浏览器中渲染Markdown内容。
• echoangle指出一个潜在的bug，即在特定情况下，帖子内容会被错误替换。
• _fat_santa曾经使用纯HTML页面，后来转向Astro，认为这是构建内容驱动网站的优秀平台。
• 90s_dev分享了一些简化博客搭建的技巧，包括避免使用frontmatter和分页，以及使用JSX作为服务器端字符串构建工具。
• emadda使用Bun JS和HTML字符串，通过Bun的--hot标志实现静态HTML的自动更新。
• FlyingSnake推荐使用Hugo/Zola和Cloudflare Pages搭建标准静态博客，并遵循512kb指南优化页面大小。
• Rush2112建议使用工具如mdrss从Markdown文件生成RSS feed。
• karaterobot展示了一个极简博客设计，仅包含一个大页面和761个帖子，无分类页面和搜索功能，但速度极快。
• abhisek认为技术选择应根据使用场景决定，简单的博客可能逐渐需要更多功能，如评论系统和数据库支持。

补充讨论：
• 博客搭建中功能与简洁性的平衡是讨论的焦点。有些人倾向于保持简单，专注于写作，而另一些人则逐步添加功能以满足读者需求。
• 静态网站生成器和CMS之间的选择涉及对技术细节和维护成本的考虑。
• 添加RSS feed和按日期排序等基本功能被认为是博客的重要组成部分。
• 讨论中还涉及自定义系统和现有工具的权衡，包括对代码简洁性和功能扩展性的关注。

data.title: Anatomy of a 'zombie' volcano: Investigating the cause of unrest inside Uturuncu
data.author: docmechanic
data.article_summary: 科学家通过联合分析玻利维亚乌图伦库火山（被称为“僵尸”火山，因其虽已25万年未喷发但仍显示活动迹象）的内在活动，排除了近期喷发的可能性。研究结合了地震学、物理模型和岩石成分分析，发现火山的不稳定源于火山下方的液体和气体运动，导致中心区域隆起。研究团队利用超过1700次地震事件的信号，对火山浅地壳内的通道系统进行了高分辨率成像，确认火山喷发的风险较低。该研究由中国、英国和美国的大学合作完成，相关成果发表于《PNAS》期刊。研究方法可应用于其他类似火山，帮助理解其潜在危害和资源。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：科学家对玻利维亚乌图伦库火山（被称为“僵尸”火山）的活动原因进行了研究，重点在于平息人们对火山即将爆发的担忧。

不同观点：
• 观点一（支持研究结论）：docmechanic 引用的摘要表明，科学家通过结合地震学、物理模型和岩石成分分析，研究了乌图伦库火山的不稳定活动，并得出了减轻人们对即将爆发恐惧的结论。这表明研究提供了科学依据，帮助公众理解火山的现状，排除了短期内大规模爆发的可能性。
  - 论据：多学科方法（地震学、物理模型、岩石成分分析）的结合。
  - 例子：明确指出研究帮助缓解了对火山爆发的担忧。

• 观点二（潜在的质疑或谨慎态度）：虽然研究得出了减轻恐慌的结论，但并未完全排除未来火山活动的可能性。一些讨论可能围绕火山监测的长期性和潜在风险的不确定性展开，暗示仍需持续关注。
  - 论据：尽管当前研究表明没有迫在眉睫的危险，火山活动本质上具有不确定性。
  - 例子：历史上一些火山在长期休眠后突然爆发，因此不能掉以轻心。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：虽然科学研究结果缓解了公众对火山即将爆发的恐惧，但部分讨论可能集中于科学预测的局限性和对火山长期监测的必要性。
• 其他值得注意的讨论点：多学科方法被视为提高火山活动研究准确性的关键，这可能在科学界引发关于不同领域合作重要性的讨论。

总结：讨论的核心在于科学家通过多学科研究缓解了公众对乌图伦库火山即将爆发的担忧，但仍存在对火山活动长期监测必要性的潜在关注和争议。
